name: Emburse Expense Analytics
description: Employee travel & expense analytics for Emburse customers: spend, policy compliance, approval and reimbursement cycle times, audit risk and VAT recovery. One row per expense line, daily from Oct 2024 to Oct 2026.

columns.name: Expense Line ID
columns.desc: Unique identifier of an individual expense line.

columns.name: Report ID
columns.desc: Expense report the line belongs to; one report per trip or per employee-month.

columns.name: Transaction Date
columns.desc: Date the expense was incurred.

columns.name: Submitted Date
columns.desc: Date the expense report was submitted for approval; empty for drafts.

columns.name: Report Status
columns.desc: Workflow status: Draft, Pending Approval, Returned, Approved, Exported or Reimbursed.

columns.name: Employee
columns.desc: Employee who incurred the expense.

columns.name: Department
columns.desc: Employee's department.

columns.name: Cost Center
columns.desc: Cost center the expense is charged to (department by region).

columns.name: Approver
columns.desc: Manager responsible for approving the report.

columns.name: Region
columns.desc: Region where the expense was incurred: North America, EMEA or APAC.

columns.name: Country
columns.desc: Country where the expense was incurred.

columns.name: City
columns.desc: City where the expense was incurred (trip destination or home office).

columns.name: Currency
columns.desc: Original transaction currency.

columns.name: Expense Category
columns.desc: Expense type such as Airfare, Lodging, Meals & Entertainment, Ground Transport or Mileage.

columns.name: Merchant
columns.desc: Normalized merchant name.

columns.name: Merchant Category
columns.desc: Merchant category code group, e.g. Airlines, Hotels & Lodging, Restaurants & Bars.

columns.name: Payment Method
columns.desc: Corporate Card, Out-of-Pocket, P-Card or Travel Agency (TMC).

columns.name: Policy Status
columns.desc: In Policy, Soft Violation, Hard Violation or Missing Receipt.

columns.name: Policy Flag
columns.desc: Specific policy rule triggered, e.g. Over Hotel Cap, Alcohol on Receipt, Duplicate Suspected; None when compliant.

columns.name: Project / Client
columns.desc: Client or matter the expense is billable to; Internal when not billable.

columns.name: Expense Amount
columns.desc: Expense amount converted to USD.

columns.name: Out-of-Policy Amount
columns.desc: Portion of the expense amount that breaches policy.

columns.name: Violations
columns.desc: Number of policy violations.

columns.name: Missing Receipts
columns.desc: Number of expense lines missing a receipt.

columns.name: Approval Days
columns.desc: Days from submission to approval.

columns.name: Reimbursement Days
columns.desc: Days from approval to employee reimbursement (out-of-pocket lines).

columns.name: Days Pending
columns.desc: Days a report has been waiting for approval (pending reports only).

columns.name: Audit Risk Score
columns.desc: AI audit risk score from 0 to 100; higher means riskier.

columns.name: VAT Reclaimable
columns.desc: Recoverable VAT/GST on eligible non-US expenses, in USD.

columns.name: Negotiated Hotel Rate
columns.desc: Corporate negotiated nightly hotel rate for the city (lodging lines only).

columns.name: Miles
columns.desc: Miles claimed on mileage expenses.

formulas.name: Out-of-Policy %
formulas.desc: Share of spend that breaches policy.

formulas.name: Hotel Rate vs Negotiated %
formulas.desc: How far actual nightly hotel spend runs above the negotiated rate.
